gates.accountable: Engine application engineer, hydraulic supplier and drivetrain engineer
gates.blocks: Adapter/bellhousing, coupling, guard and engine/pump mount fabrication; no bolt pattern guessed.

gates.blocks: Gearcase, shafts, axle drive and torque-reaction mounts. Motor must not receive unsupported gear/chain/belt side load by assumption.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Verify command neutral and actual pump/speed/brake state. Hold independent brakes during engine/charge warm-up. Interlock boarding doors/gates and emergency circuit before traction permission.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Sensors, proof logic, warm-up/charge pressure criteria and release thresholds.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Prove train brakes released using engineered means before applying tractive torque. Ramp torque/jerk and limit pressure/displacement by engine torque/power, pump shaft and adhesion constraints. Do not require full-speed engine for low rail speed by assumption.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Controlled transition that avoids rollback, brake drag and torque surge. Exact engine-speed schedule and hydraulic map.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Monitor independent vehicle speed, engine speed, both loop pressures, charge pressure, hottest oil temperature, case pressure where required and air readiness. Preserve a separate hotel-power load boundary.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Fault thresholds, diagnostics, redundancy and component control code.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Coordinate traction removal and independent air-service braking. Hydrostatic retardation must be bounded against engine overspeed and low-loop pressure; it is not the sole stop or hold system.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Blend timing, motor back-driving behavior, engine absorption and brake balance.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Require an accepted standstill criterion and brake hold, then neutral proof and a deliberate direction command. Reversing pump flow at speed is not a permitted shortcut.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Exact forward/reverse mapping, switch interlocks and speed criteria.

control_requirements_not_implemented.state: Emergency, loss of command/power or pressure
control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Inhibit propulsion through an engineered safe path and initiate independent emergency braking appropriate to the fault. Verify spring-brake application cannot be inadvertently prevented or create uncontrolled wheel slide.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Fault-tree review, energy reserves, fail states, application rate and complete consist response.

control_requirements_not_implemented.required_behavior: Secure train mechanically and follow the delivered unit's restricted bypass/recovery instructions. Engine-off towing cannot assume charge flow or lubrication.
control_requirements_not_implemented.unresolved: Approved recovery speed/distance, isolation and redundant holding method.

test_development.scope: Supplier/application review and guarded bench rig
test_development.measure: Exact order codes; spline engagement and torsion; speed/torque/flow/pressure; charge and case pressure; actual heat at representative hot/cold points.
test_development.release: Engineer-approved fixture, instrumentation and limits before energizing.

test_development.scope: Locomotive only on controlled test track
test_development.measure: Actual axle weights; neutral creep; low-speed cogging; directional mapping; independent brake hold against accepted maximum drive; emergency behavior.
test_development.release: Rail/control/brake engineer test plan; no passengers.

test_development.measure: Drawbar pull and running/breakaway drag; acceleration/speed; compressor recharge and full-train brake response; adverse adhesion safely simulated under an accepted plan.
test_development.release: Approved ballast, instrumentation, exclusion zone and recovery method.

test_development.scope: Thermal endurance at accepted design condition
test_development.measure: Ambient at each heat exchanger inlet, oil case temperatures, coolant, charge/case pressures, fan/air restriction, DPF event and stop/load cycle.
test_development.release: Accepted steady temperature and time-to-equilibrium criterion. No cooler is released by arithmetic alone.

crew_boundary.farm_crew: Maintenance-access review, nonpowered clearance mockups and data collection under the approved plan.
crew_boundary.specialists: Rail/drivetrain/brake/control engineering, safety-critical machining/fabrication, hydraulic cleanliness/pressure work, engine emissions installation and instrumented commissioning.
